---
name: ✨ Feature request
about: Suggest a new tool, game, or improvement
title: '[feat] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Is your request related to a problem?**
A description of what's missing or frustrating, e.g. "I always need to open a separate site to decode JWTs..."

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you'd like to see — a new dev tool, a new game, a new terminal command, better a11y...

**Where should it live?**
- [ ] Dev Tools Hub (`features/tools.html`)
- [ ] Arcade Zone (`features/games.html`)
- [ ] Terminal (`features/terminal.html`)
- [ ] Visual Playground (`features/visuals.html`)
- [ ] Core portfolio (`index.html`)
- [ ] CLI (`bin/ritesh-cli.js`)

**Constraints to respect**
This repo is deliberately **zero-dependency vanilla JS** — features should work offline with no build step.

**Additional context**
Mockups, links, examples.
